_meta.description: P17 read-only Tango capability/tier probe — sanitized report attached to the handoff. Produced by apps/api/scripts/diag-tango-capabilities.ts run against the REAL account (never fixtures). No response body is ever captured (see tango-capability-probe.service.ts — a successful call's `reason` is always the literal string "Call succeeded."), and every error `reason` is redacted through the same redact()/redactWithKnownSecret() pipeline the product gateway (tango.client.ts) uses. Nothing in this file, including the ARN below, is a credential.
findings: Authentication succeeded — the real key is live and working.

14 of 24 probed capabilities are supported outright: version, opportunities, notice_history, forecasts, vehicles, contracts, idvs, otas, otidvs, protests, budget_accounts_flows, webhook_event_types, webhook_endpoints_list, api_keys_list.

attachment_metadata and extracted_text (searchOpportunityAttachments, both calls) answered a synthetic single-character query with a classified 404 rather than 200 + an empty page — reported as the dedicated 'not_found' status (added to ProbeStatus specifically because of this finding), not generic 'error'. P29/P30 should investigate directly with a real query before assuming either 'broken' or 'fine' — a 404 from a search endpoint is unusual enough to be worth a deliberate look, not an assumption.

exclusions, dibbs, sbir_sttr, mcp_key_header_compatibility: confirmed genuinely unsupported by @makegov/tango-node@1.1.0 (no method exists) — P40/P41/P42/P43/P45/P39 cannot assume these datasets are reachable through this SDK version.
webhook_write_apis: deliberately not attempted (mutating) — P46/P47's documentation-discrepancy question is NOT resolved by this run.

entities/vehicle_awardees/vehicle_orders/budget_flows_by_entity: not_attempted because this run supplied no --uei/--vehicle-uuid — re-run with a real identifier before P19-P23 rely on those specific findings.
requestsIssued stayed at 16 of a 30 ceiling; rate-limit headers show a 25-requests-per-window cap on this account/tier (P18 should account for this).
